sections.title: Scenario events
sections.note: Meet her at this place and time to start the scene; talking costs 1 Heart Clock. Bond choices: +25 small, +50 medium, +100 big. Some days have different scenes depending on her Connection level. "Unlimited" scenes repeat after day 21.

rows.label: I stumble upon Noir standing alone amongst the bamboo.

rows.text: What did you wish for?
I hope whatever you wished for comes true.

rows.label: I find Noir in the restaurant.

rows.text: Sit beside Noir.
Sit across from Noir.
Yes, I heard.
No, I didn't know that.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the waterfall.

rows.text: Good things, I hope.
And I was thinking about you.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the waterfall.

rows.text: But what if it isn't a prank?
I've got a bone to pick with her myself.

rows.label: I find Noir at the waterfall.

rows.text: Just in case, let's look a bit more.
Let's go somewhere else to search.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: For Noir to be happy forever and ever?
For all of us to have a nice time at Snowfield Hot Spring?

rows.label: I stumble upon Noir standing alone amongst the bamboo.

rows.text: How can that be, when you're the personification of luck itself?
I'm sure nothing will happen.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: You look even more radiant than usual.
Something smells absolutely lovely.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: What do you call a dead almond?
I can't think of anything. How about I sing you a lullaby?

rows.label: I find Blanc at the walking trail.

rows.text: Is everything ready for the event later?
What kind of event do you have planned?

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: It was nice.
To be honest, it didn't really live up to my expectations.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Maybe it's the comedown from yesterday's big event?
Maybe because you got too relaxed from a soak in the hot spring?

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Hold their hands.
Pat them both on the shoulder.

rows.label: I find Noir at the walking trail.

rows.text: What a cute white bunny!
It's a mini Blanc!

rows.label: I find Noir at the walking trail.

rows.text: Why don't you get some more rest yourself?
So you decided to head out for a bit after resting?
Achoo!
Don't worry. I'm as fit as a fiddle.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: First time I've heard of it.
I've heard of it.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: First time I've heard of it.
I've heard of it.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: Wake Noir.
Let Noir sleep uninterrupted.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: What are you two doing?
Yes, I plan on resting for a while.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: Very pretty.
It's pretty, but it looks like it needs some tidying up.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: What is it?
This can't possibly be what I think it is.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: Sorry about that. Let's use the time we have left to talk a little more.
I thought I was paying you the proper amount of attention, but I guess not.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: I'll help you both solve this mystery.
I'll figure it out for you.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: That can't be it.
No, but you are scary in another sense.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: You weren't thinking of something dirty, were you?
Were you thinking of me?

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: I'm supposed to meet you two here. Don't tell me you forgot already.
I didn't make any plans with anyone.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Are you still not feeling well?
Are you getting any better?

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Maybe Lumi wasn't feeling too good herself?
Don't worry, it won't always be like this.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Are we diving back into the family roleplay again?
Sorry to keep you waiting.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: I didn't realize you felt that way.
I'll give you the rest of my time.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Let's try our best to use what time we have left wisely.
I'm not sure if we have enough time.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Don't think about it too much.
At least we have something to go on now.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: We've experienced a lot of enjoyable moments together.
There have been many times where I've been left scratching my head.
I can't decide, since everything I did with you was so nice.
I also enjoyed being a family most of all.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the walking trail.

rows.text: Are you sure you won't get tired of it?
That's precisely why I come here every day.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: A rabbit?
A snow sculpture?

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: What is going on here?
What are you doing? You're getting me a little hot under the collar...

rows.label: I find Noir at the waterfall.

rows.text: There must be something.
We should figure out the secret behind the legend.

rows.label: I find Noir at the waterfall.

rows.text: You played a big part as well, Noir.
You played a big part as well, Darling.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the walking trail.

rows.text: There must be something.
We should figure out the secret behind the legend.

rows.label: I find Blanc at the walking trail.

rows.text: You did well, Blanc.
You did well, Darling.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: Ugh, what is that smell?
What's that smell?

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: I really don't want to leave this place.
Sorry, but I have to hurry and get back.

rows.label: I find Noir and Blanc at the hot spring.

rows.text: I wanted to take one final look as well.
I thought you two might be here.

rows.label: I find Noir at the walking trail.

rows.text: I came to feel the breeze on my face.
I came here to talk to you one-on-one before we leave.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: Funny, I did the same thing.
I came back here to talk to you one last time before we left.

rows.label: I find Noir in the dormitory.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
Just killing time.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the bamboo forest.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I wanted to take a look at all the notes hanging here.

rows.label: I find Noir at the walking trail.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I felt like going on a walk.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the restaurant.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
Just came to grab a quick meal.

rows.label: As I'm walking about, I see Noir by herself at the hot spring.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I wanted to take a soak in the water.

rows.label: I find Blanc in the dormitory.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
Just needed a quick rest.

sections.title: Noir's mood by level
sections.note: The diary line shown at each Connection level.
items: She seems more interested in Blanc and Snowfield Hot Spring now.
She is thinking about what happened in the bamboo forest.
She's worrying whether she's done anything that might've hurt Lumi.
She seems to have found clues to the legend of the hot spring.
She's thinking about the meaning of family while blushing.
She won't forget the day the three of them enjoyed the hot spring together.

sections.title: Blanc's mood by level
sections.note: The diary line shown at each Connection level.
items: She seems more interested in Noir and Snowfield Hot Spring now.
She is thinking about what happened in the hot spring.
She's looking for Lumi to figure out the secret of the legend.
She still looks excited although she's saddened about not being the mom.
She won't forget the day the three of them enjoyed the hot spring together.
